title.narrative: Empowerment for All: Upscaling Education, Protection and WASH services for Vulnerable Populations in Batroun, Koura, and Zgharta Districts

description.narrative:
ltpgtltspan style="font-size: 14px line-height: 107%"gtDue to the Syrian war, economic deterioration and political deadlock, Lebanon suffers from a severe humanitarian crisis. This has inflicted catastrophic economic and social consequences, intensifying poverty and worsening development. Vulnerable populations, particularly children and adolescents living in poverty, endure cumulative deprivations such as being out of school, are subjected to violence both in schools and in their homes, engaged in child labor affectinglt/spangtltspan lang="EN-GB" style="font-size: 14px line-height: 107%"gt about 100,000 children (4 to 6%, depending on nationality)lta title="" name="_ftnref1" href="#_ftn1"gtltspan class="MsoFootnoteReference"gtltspan lang="EN-GB"gt[1]lt/spangtlt/spangtlt/agt,lt/spangtltspan style="font-size: 14px line-height: 107%"gt or forced into child marriage. The crisis also undermines parents' ability to care for and safeguard children. They thus resort to negative coping mechanisms, restricting access to education, pushing girls into early marriages, and subjecting children to labor and begging. The long-term consequences on children will persist throughout their lives. Educating and protecting children and adolescents requires an effective intervention based on the priorities set by the relevant sectors.lt/spangtltbrgtlt/pgt
ltp style="margin: 12pt 0in" class="MsoNormal"gtltspan style="line-height: 107%"gtRMF has designed a lt/spangtltspan style="line-height: 107%"gt12-month multi-sectoral humanitarian project to enhance the well-being and resilience of identified communities. The project will focus on the following districts: Zgharta, Koura, and Batroun. lt/spangtlt/pgt
ltp style="margin: 12pt 0in" class="MsoNormal"gtltspan style="line-height: 107%"gtThe intervention objectives are: lt/spangtlt/pgt
ltp style="margin: 12pt 0in" class="MsoNormal"gtltspan style="line-height: 107%"gtObjective 1: ltspan class="ui-provider ga b c d e f g h i j k l m n o p q r s t u v w x y z ab ac ae af ag ah ai aj ak" dir="ltr"gtImprove access to quality education for vulnerable Lebanese and Syrian children in targeted localities through a comprehensive approachlt/spangt
lt/spangtlt/pgt
ltp style="margin: 12pt 0in" class="MsoNormal"gtltspan style="line-height: 107%"gtThis includes:lt/spangtlt/pgt
ltulgtltligtltspan style="line-height: 107%"gtRetention support for 120 schooled students (70% Lebanese, and 30% Syrian refugees) in grades 6, 7, 8 and 11 at risk of dropping out of school
lt/spangtlt/ligtltligtltspan style="line-height: 107%"gtSupplementary Summer Program incorporating learning and well-being activities for 240 students (70% Lebanese, and 30% Syrian refugees)
in grades 1 to 8 including children with specific needslt/spangtlt/ligtltligtGrades 9 and 12 official exams' support for 180 Lebanese studentslt/ligtltligtltspan style="font-size: 14px"gtExtending cash for Education for children benefitting from retention support and official exams' supportlt/spangtlt/ligtltligtltspan style="font-size: 14px"gtDistributing back-to-school kits to children benefitting from retention support and official exams' supportlt/spangtltbrgtlt/ligtltligtltspan style="font-size: 14px"gtDelivering teach materials to 180 students benefitting from official exams' supportlt/spangtlt/ligtltligtltspan style="line-height: 107%"gtOffering healthy snacks for children benefitting from retention support and supplementary summer programmelt/spangtlt/ligtltligtltspan style="line-height: 107%"gtStrengthening the capacities of 40 teachers and school principals lt/spangtlt/ligtltligtltspan style="line-height: 107%"gtActivating and engaging Parent Teacher Associationslt/spangtlt/ligtlt/ulgt
ltp style="margin: 12pt 0in" class="MsoNormal"gtltspan style="line-height: 107%"gtObjective 2lt/spangtltspan style="line-height: 107%"gt: Improve access to child protection services for vulnerable Lebanese and Syrian children in targeted localities segregated by type of vulnerability. lt/spangtlt/pgt
ltp style="margin: 12pt 0in" class="MsoNormal"gtltspan style="line-height: 107%"gtThis will be achieved through:lt/spangtlt/pgt
ltulgtltligtltspan style="line-height: 107%"gtCreating safe spaces for children with a special focus on those engaged in child labor and/or street connected lt/spangtlt/ligtltligtltspan style="line-height: 107%"gtOrganizing 6 SBC activities for raising awareness and fostering positive behaviors in targeted communitieslt/spangtlt/ligtltligtltspan style="line-height: 107%"gtProviding FPSS activities adapted and contextualized to the age group and vulnerability of 120 children (70% Lebanese and 30% Syrian refugees), identified medium to high-risk lt/spangtlt/ligtltligtltspan style="line-height: 107%"gtProviding CBSS activities for 225 children (70% Lebanese and 30% Syrian refugees) having siblings or relatives engaged in child labor, drug abuse, and early marriagelt/spangtlt/ligtltligtltspan style="line-height: 107%"gtProviding parenting program for 150 caregivers of the children benefitting from FPSSlt/spangtlt/ligtltligtltspan style="line-height: 107%"gtProviding case management services to 120 (70% Lebanese and 30% Syrian refugees) high risk childrenlt/spangtlt/ligtltligtltspan style="line-height: 107%"gtProvide emergency cash assistance to 60 high risk cases (50% of total caseload)lt/spangtlt/ligtlt/ulgt
ltp style="margin: 12pt 0in" class="MsoNormal"gtltspan style="line-height: 107%"gtObjective 3:lt/spangtltspan style="line-height: 107%"gt Enhance access to hygiene practices and services among vulnerable communities through:lt/spangtlt/pgt
ltulgtltligtltspan style="line-height: 107%"gtDistributing hygiene kits for 200 men and boyslt/spangtlt/ligtltligtltspan style="line-height: 107%"gtDistributing MHM kits for 400 girls and womenlt/spangtlt/ligtltligtltspan style="line-height: 107%"gtConducting awareness-raising activities on sanitation and hygiene, targeting 600 beneficiarieslt/spangtlt/ligtlt/ulgt
ltp style="" class=""gtltspan style="line-height: 107%"gtlt/spangtlt/pgt
ltp style="margin: 12pt 0in" class="MsoNormal"gtltspan style="line-height: 107%"gtActivities will take place in public schools, community centers, and/or Social and Development Centers. Collaboration with service providers such as Himaya, INTERSOS, Al Fayhaa, MAKANI Partners, World Vision, War Child Holland and UPEL will be prioritized.lt/spangtltspan style="line-height: 107%"gtlt/spangtlt/pgt
